The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of SiO2 and Fe2O3 can effectively increase the thermal conductivity of risers covering,which can improve the heat transfer efficiency and shorten the riser time.
the use of the flux can reduce the temperature of the riser and the temperature gradient of the molten steel,which can reduce the thermal stress in the riser.

a new type of riser covering flux with high melting point,high thermal conductivity,good fluidity and good thermal insulation property can be prepared by adding SiO2,graphite,Fe2O 3 and other materials to the traditional covering flux.The thermal insulation property of the new type covering flux was better than that of the traditional covering flux.
